evidence: The commenter found Middlemak minimized finger travel and awkward motions without discarding much QWERTY muscle memory.

evidence_sources.author: tpmoney
evidence_sources.excerpt: I tried a couple different layouts and landed on something called "middlemak"[1]. Of all the ones I tried, it really felt like the one with the least overall finger travel and awkward things to type in my day to day software development work
